title: Myth vs. Fact: Does Boiling Water Clear PVC Drain Clogs?
description: A common DIY myth is that pouring boiling water down a clogged sink will safely dissolve grease blockages. In reality, water heated to boiling temperatures can exceed the continuous temperature rating of standard residential PVC drain pipes and rubber slip-joint washers. Heat can soften or deform PVC joints, creating leaks under the sink. Furthermore, melted grease only travels a short distance down the pipe before cooling down, re-solidifying, and creating a deeper blockage in the main branch drain. Professional drain clearing relies on mechanical augers or enzyme-based cleaners safe for plastic piping.

Myth vs. Fact: Does Boiling Water Clear PVC Drain Clogs?

A common DIY myth is that pouring boiling water down a clogged sink will safely dissolve grease blockages. In reality, water heated to boiling temperatures can exceed the continuous temperature rating of standard residential PVC drain pipes and rubber slip-joint washers. Heat can soften or deform PVC joints, creating leaks under the sink. Furthermore, melted grease only travels a short distance down the pipe before cooling down, re-solidifying, and creating a deeper blockage in the main branch drain. Professional drain clearing relies on mechanical augers or enzyme-based cleaners safe for plastic piping.
